note: An independent-in-method source qualification of the 71 proposed Gate 0C.3 dispositions. It records what the route source supports, contests or cannot show. It accepts no disposition, changes no severity and fills no approval field.

review.limitation: The reviewer belongs to the same engineering-agent family that prepared the Gate 0C.3 registers. The review re-reads the source with a separate extractor and shares no code with the Gate 0C.3 builder, so it is independent in method. It is not an authority-independent approval and it accepts, ratifies and authorizes nothing.
method: Route wrappers and role floors are re-extracted from each route file by a separate extractor that does not read any Gate 0C.3 register.
Each cited quotation is searched in its cited file.
Each affected operation is looked up in the classified inventory and in its route file.
Each proposed disposition is tested against the rubric precondition the Gate 0C.3 register itself states.
Each absence claim is searched for a contradicting token in the cited source.
The 150-item index is rebuilt from the frozen registers and compared.
notDone: No test, database, browser, deployment or role-title check was run.
No disposition, severity, owner or decision was changed.
No authority-independent reviewer has accepted any record.

statusDefinitions.SOURCE_VERIFIED: Every check the route source can settle agrees with the assessment and no absence claim is made that source cannot prove.
statusDefinitions.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: The route source supports part of the assessment and contests, narrows or cannot prove another part. The named findings say which.
statusDefinitions.INFERENCE_ONLY: The route source recomputes nothing the assessment states.
statusDefinitions.REQUIRES_RUNTIME_PROOF: The disposition rests on a fact (row-level security, a database, a deployment value or a browser) that no reading of the repository can supply. This status takes precedence over the source-verification status of the same record; the source status is carried separately.

separation: A qualification record is not an acceptance. The proposed disposition keeps state PROPOSED_NOT_ACCEPTED and every approval field stays empty.
